title: Assessing in vivo presentation of exogenous antigen in the tumor microenvironment in mice
protocol: Lethally irradiate 8-12 week old female recipient mice (S100a8CreLSL-USAPyMT, CD45.1.2+) with 900 rad 12-24 hours before bone marrow transfer.
Maintain the mice on antibiotic sulfatrim diet for at least two weeks post-irradiation and post-bone marrow transfer.
Euthanize donor mice and harvest both femurs and tibias from adult female donor mice.
Remove the muscle from the bones, clean bones in 70% ethanol, and wash in sterile PBS.
Mash bones using mortar and pestle in sterile biological safety cabinet.
Collect mashed bone marrow in T cell media (TCM) and pass it through a 70 μm cell strainer into a 50 mL conical tube to obtain single-cell suspension.
Take small aliquot (∼20 μL) for counting.
Mix 10 μL 0.4% trypan blue with 10 μL cells to count.
Let sit 3 min at 20°C–25°C.
Pipette 10 μL underneath coverslip of hemacytometer.
Place hemacytometer on microscope and count number of cells that have not taken up the dye (live cells) in each of the four outer quadrants.

Calculate number of live cells in sample: (number of cells in four quadrants/4) × (10^4) = number of cells per mL, then (number of cells per mL) × (total volume of cells [unit in mL]) for final cell number.
Ensure comparable numbers of cells (i.e., ∼60–80 × 10^6 per mouse).
Mix bulk bone marrow from two donor mice at a 1 to 1 ratio.
Spin down the mixture for 6 minutes at 4°C and 550 rcf.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend in appropriate volume of sterile PBS (100 μL per recipient mouse, total volume up to 500 μL).
Inject 100 μL mixed bone marrow intravenously into an irradiated recipient mouse via retro-orbital injection using a 500 μL syringe.
Monitor mammary glands weekly for tumor growth.
Scruff the mouse by the neck and palp each of the ten mammary glands to measure tumors.
Measure “length” and “width” of the tumor with a caliper.
Calculate tumor volume per gland using the formula: tumor volume = [(length × width²) × (π/6)].
Record ten values per mouse, one per gland.
Sum values to calculate total tumor burden for that mouse.
Euthanize mice when total tumor burden reaches ∼ 2,000 mm³.
Dissect out tumors and tumor-draining lymph nodes.
Transfer minced tumor tissue into a 50 mL conical tube with 8 mL HBSS without Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺.
Add 280 U/mL Collagenase Type 3 and 4 μg/mL Dnase I to the tube.
Vortex for 5 seconds.
Incubate in 37°C water bath for 1 hour.
Vortex every 15 minutes during incubation.
Mash resulting tissue through a 70 μm cell strainer with the back of a 3 mL syringe plunger.
Add an additional 20 mL chilled PBS during washes of the strainer.
Spin down the tube containing the tumor sample for 6 minutes at 4°C and 550 rcf.
Resuspend the pellet in 7 mL 44% Percoll.
Transfer the suspension to a 15 mL conical tube.
Slowly add 3 mL 66% Percoll to the bottom of the tube.
Centrifuge the sample for 30 minutes at 4°C and 1,900 rcf with no brake.
Remove debris from the top of the 44% Percoll layer.
Collect cells at the interface between the 44% and 66% Percoll layers.
Transfer collected cells to a new 15 mL conical tube.
Add chilled PBS to the cells, bringing the volume up to 12 mL.
Vortex the tube well.
Spin the tube for 6 minutes at 4°C and 550 rcf.
Visually inspect the tube to ensure cells are pelleted at the bottom of the tube.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL TCM.
Keep the suspension on ice until ready to start antibody stainings.
Mince lymph node tissue with a razor blade on a glass slide.
Transfer minced lymph node to a 15 mL conical tube with 4.5 mL T cell media and 280 U/mL Collagenase Type 3.
Vortex the mixture for 5 seconds.
Place the tube in a 37°C water bath.
Incubate the sample in the water bath for 30 minutes, vortexing every 15 minutes.
Add 500 μL of 0.1 M EDTA to the sample, bringing the volume up to 5 mL.
Vortex briefly and incubate in a 37°C water bath for another 5 minutes.
Remove the tube from the water bath.
Vortex and incubate on ice for 5 minutes.
Mash resulting tissue through a 70 μm cell strainer with the back of a 3 mL syringe plunger into a 50 mL conical tube, adding an additional 10 mL PBS during washes of the strainer.
Spin the tube for 6 minutes at 4°C and 550 rcf.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL T cell media.
Keep on ice until ready to start antibody stainings.
Transfer cells to a 96 well U-bottom plate.
Spin down the plate for 3 minutes at 4°C and 700 rcf.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend samples in 50 μL FACS staining buffer with fluorescently conjugated antibodies against surface proteins of interest.
Incubate sample for 30 min on ice protected from light.
Add 150 μL FACS buffer to each well.
Spin down plate for 3 min at 4°C and 700 rcf.
Discard supernatant.
Wash cells by resuspending in 200 μL FACS buffer.
Spin down plate for 3 min at 4°C and 700 rcf.
Discard supernatant.
Repeat steps f-g for additional wash.
Resuspend samples in 100 μL Fix/Perm to fix and permeabilize the cells.
Incubate cells for 30 min on ice protected from light.
Add 100 μL Fix/Perm buffer to each well.
Spin down plate for 3 min at 4°C and 860 rcf.
Discard supernatant.
Wash fixed cells by resuspending in 200 μL Fix/Perm buffer.
Spin down plate for 3 min at 4°C and 860 rcf.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend samples in 50 μL Fix/Perm buffer with fluorescently conjugated antibodies against intracellular proteins.
Incubate on ice for 30 min.
Repeat steps k-o.
Resuspend samples in 100 μL FACS buffer.
Transfer cells through nylon mesh material into 1.2 mL microtiter tube.
Run sample on flow cytometer, including appropriate compensation controls.
Analyze resulting data to determine TAM phenotype in the mixed bone marrow chimera system.
Measure expression of exogenous tumor antigen (SIINFEKL) presented on the surface of CD45.1+ versus CD45.2+ TAMs.
Confirm IRF8 deletion and altered TAM expression of MHC-II in CD45.2+ TAMs.
Resuspend pellet in 15 mL conical tube with 50 μL per 1 × 10^6 cells FACS staining buffer with fluorescently conjugated antibodies against surface proteins of interest.

Note: Sample antibody panel for tumor TAM sort includes FcBlock, PerCPCy5.5 – CD45, v450 – CD45.2, APC-Cy7 – viability dye (GhostDye Red 780), PE-Cy7 – Dump channel [Ly6C, Ly6G, SiglecF], PE-TexasRed – F4/80, BV605 – MHC-II, BV650 – CD45.1, BV711 – CD11b.
Mix 1 μg of FcBlock with 50 μL for blocking.
Incubate on ice for 30 minutes protected from light.
Add 5 mL of FACS buffer and spin down the tube for 6 minutes at 4°C and 550 rcf.
Discard the supernatant.
Repeat steps c-d twice more.
Resuspend cell pellet in an appropriate volume of sorting buffer to achieve a concentration of 10 × 10^6 cells per mL for sorting with a 100 μm nozzle on BD Aria.
Pass cells through a 70 μm cell filter cap for a 5 mL tube before transferring them to a 5 mL polypropylene tube.
Sort tumor and dLN samples on BD Aria using a 100 μm nozzle, including appropriate compensation controls for setting up the instrument.
Euthanize one adult OT-I mouse.
Harvest lymph nodes from the euthanized mouse.
Mash lymph nodes between two glass slides and wipe off into a tissue culture dish with chilled PBS.
Pipette cell suspension through a 70 μm cell strainer into a conical tube.
Isolate naïve CD8+ T cells using a negative-selection isolation kit following manufacturer’s instructions.
Stain OT-I T cells with CellTrace Violet (CTV).
Reconstitute CTV tube with 20 μL DMSO.
Add 1 μL CTV to 1 mL PBS.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL PBS.
Add 1 mL PBS + CTV to cells and pipette up and down to mix (total volume of 2 mL).
Incubate in 37°C water bath for 15 min.
Bring volume up to 15 mL with warmed TCM.
Spin down tube for 6 min at 4°C and 550 rcf.
Resuspend pellet in 10 mL warmed TCM.
Spin down tube for 6 min at 4°C and 550 rcf.
Resuspend pellet in 10 mL warmed TCM and incubate in water bath for 10 min to ensure all unbound CTV is absorbed.
Take 10 μL aliquot for counting.
Spin down tube for 6 min at 4°C and 550 rcf.
Count number of live CTV-stained OT-I T cells.
Resuspend OT-I in appropriate volume of TCM for coculture experiment (15,000 T cells per 100 μL).
Plate 100 μL OT-I cells to wells of a 96 U-bottom plate.
Include wells without antigen presenting cells added to measure no proliferation.
Prepare TAMs in TCM at varying concentrations for coculture (TAM:OT-I at 1:1 [15,000 TAMs per 100 μL], 3:1 [45,000 TAMs per 100 μL], and 10:1 [150,000 TAMs per 100 μL]).
Add 100 μL TAMs to wells with 100 μL OT-I, with a total volume of 200 μL.
Prepare mDC1 in TCM at the appropriate concentration for coculture (e.g., mDC1:OT-I at 1:3 [5,000 mDC1 per 100 μL]).
Add 100 μL of mDC1 to wells containing 100 μL OT-I, resulting in a total volume of 200 μL.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for 72 hours.
Stain samples with fluorescently conjugated antibodies for flow cytometry after 3 days of coculture.
Spin down the plate for 3 minutes at 4°C and 700 rcf, then discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 200 μL FACS buffer.
Spin down the plate again for 3 minutes at 4°C and 700 rcf, then discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 50 μL FACS staining buffer per 1 × 10^6 cells with fluorescently conjugated antibodies against surface proteins of interest.
Incubate plate on ice for 30 min.
Wash unfixed samples three times with FACS buffer.
Resuspend samples in 100 μL FACS buffer.
Transfer cells through nylon mesh material into 1.2 mL microtiter tube.
Run samples on flow cytometer along with appropriate compensation controls.

Analyze resulting data to measure T cell proliferation via CTV dilution and T cell phenotype via expression of PD-1, comparing conditions with wild-type or IRF8-deficient TAMs and comparing different TAM:T cell ratios.
Lethally irradiate 8–12 week old female recipient mice (S100a8CreLSL-USAPyMT, CD45.1.2+) with 900 rad 12-24 hours before bone marrow transfer.
Maintain irradiated mice on sulfatrim diet for at least 2 weeks post-irradiation and post-bone marrow transfer.
Harvest bone marrow from adult donor mice (C57BL/6 CD45.2+ and MafBiCreIrf8fl/fl CD45.2+) to isolate and count cells separately.
Spin down tubes for 6 minutes at 4°C and 550 rcf after harvesting bone marrow samples.
Resuspend each sample in up to 300 μL sterile PBS, using 100 μL per recipient mouse.
Transfer single genotype bone marrow into irradiated recipient mice; one cohort receives C57BL/6 bone marrow, the other MafBiCreIrf8fl/fl bone marrow.
Age mice to allow bone marrow to graft and tumors to grow.
Monitor mice weekly for tumor growth by checking and measuring palpable tumors in mammary glands.
Isolate and transfer 1 × 10^6 OT-I CD45.1+ T cells intravenously when tumors are at least 5 mm by 5 mm.
Euthanize the OT-I mouse.
Harvest lymph nodes and spleen from the euthanized mouse.
Mash lymph nodes and spleen between two glass slides to create a single-cell suspension.
Pass mashed tissue through a 70 μm cell strainer into a 50 mL conical tube using the back of a 3 mL syringe plunger.
Pool lymph node and spleen cells together in the conical tube.
Isolate naïve CD8+ T cells using a negative-selection isolation kit following manufacturer’s instructions.
Count the number of live OT-I T cells.
Resuspend isolated cells in sterile PBS at a concentration of 1 × 10^6 cells per 100 μL PBS.
Inject 100 μL of OT-I cells into each chimeric recipient mouse.
Include a cohort with WT bone marrow and another with MafBiCreIrf8fl/fl bone marrow.
Age mice for two weeks.
Euthanize mice and process tissues to analyze phenotypes of TAMs and tumor-infiltrating T cells.
Harvest tumors and generate single cell suspension from tissue.
Split each sample in two for staining with different antibody panels.
Plate no more than 1 × 10^6 cells per well of a 96-well U-bottom plate.
Spin down plate at 4°C and 700 rcf for 3 minutes.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend samples in 50 μL FACS buffer plus antibody cocktail, one for T cell phenotype analysis, another for TAM phenotype analysis.
Incubate samples on ice for 30 minutes protected from light.
Wash samples three times with FACS buffer.
Fix and permeabilize cells before staining intracellular antibodies.
Pause point: Once cells are fixed, they can be stored at 4°C for up to 24 hours before intracellular staining and/or running samples on the flow cytometer.
Prepare samples and run on flow cytometer (see steps 13s-u).
Analyze resulting data to confirm IRF8 deletion and altered TAM phenotype.
Measure T cell phenotype via expression of molecules such as PD-1 and granzyme B, comparing cells derived from tumors with wild-type TAMs to those from tumors with IRF8-deficient TAMs.
